title: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is dead API surface — never produced
description: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs { curve: EcCurve } is a public enum variant that is documented as 'Reserved; currently not produced by decrypt()'. This variant is never constructed by the crate. The public API exposes a variant that callers cannot match on in practice. Once 0.1.0 is published this becomes dead weight in the enum that is impossible to remove without a breaking change. Either remove it before 1.0 (while non_exhaustive allows silent extension) or produce it from the KARI path in decrypt() if EcdhEs key transport is ever implemented. Note: non_exhaustive ensures callers already need _ arms, so removal later is ok — but the variant name and doc are misleading since it says 'ECDH key transport' which doesn't match KARI semantics.
